## Description
Standard 10 inch film. Polarizer films are for LCD and OLED displays on smartphone, TV, &#10;&#9;&#9;laptop, tablet, automotive display, and medical monitor. The standard polarizer is a &#10;&#9;&#9;PVA-iodine film laminated between TAC (triacetyl cellulose) protective films.
